statement: Colombo National Museum board titled STUPA FORMS displays six named stupa morphologies and diagrams of early/developed stupa plans plus a circular caitya shrine.
notes: Museum synthesis; do not infer strict chronology from form sequence.

statement: A standing bronze religious figure with elaborate headdress, jewellery and differentiated hand positions is displayed at Colombo National Museum; object identity/date/provenance are not visible in the photograph.
notes: Observation only; no deity/Bodhisattva identification without catalogue label.
